response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9 GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_hgb, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM per_patient;

assumptions.assumption: Elevated uric acid means UA strictly greater than 3.9; the request does not say whether a value exactly equal to 3.9 counts.

NULLs are ignored at each step: AVG skips NULL HGB values, and APTT - PT is NULL when either input is missing, so AVG skips those records too. A patient with no usable values in the qualifying records drops out of the across-patient averages.
The single 3.9 cutoff applies to all patients regardless of sex, as the request states. The sex-specific UA norms in the documentation are not used.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat a uric acid value exactly equal to 3.9 as elevated, so the filter is inclusive (UA >= 3.9).
